sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout returned 12 candidates across llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety. ScopeJudge ranked first but was rejected as already live by canonical URL and external_id, so the run pivoted inside the same table to SLBench.
Read arXiv abstract, HTML, and PDF text for SLBench; extracted taxonomy, sampling funnel, Table 2 results, SLGuard mitigation, human audit, grader ablation, and limitations.

Searched for third-party discussion with queries around SLBench, SkillLogic, SLGuard, and arXiv 2607.09016; found arXiv primary sources and a Cyber Security Daily Radar listing, with no substantive independent replication found.
Markdown article uses self-contained TL;DR, tables, formula blocks, Mermaid flow, pseudocode, results tables, and explicit limitations; no external image was necessary.
